justification.text: (9/4)·(log n)²/n is the problem's lower bound (9/4)(log n)²/n on the threshold, asserted only eventually (∀ᶠ n in atTop), so the single n = 0 where Lean returns 0 is irrelevant and for n ≥ 1 the divisor is positive.

Both uses are open, as the docstring states: the threshold p*(n) lies strictly between 0 and 1 (it lies between (9/4)(log n)^2/n and 1), and 'for each fixed 0 < δ < 1'. Excluding the endpoints keeps both comparison ranges nonempty, as the docstring says.

open Filter MeasureTheory StableMarriage
open scoped Topology
open Arxiv.«2406.10319»

theorem Opn.pittel_hyperbola_threshold :
    ∃ pStar : ℕ → Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      let d (n : ℕ) := min (pStar n : ℝ) (1 - (pStar n : ℝ))
      (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, (9 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.log n) ^ 2 / n < (pStar n : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∀ ε > 0, Tendsto (fun n ↦
          ⨆ p : {p : unitInterval // (pStar n : ℝ) + δ * d n ≤ (p : ℝ)},
            marketLaw n p.1 (hyperbolaEvent n p.1 ε)ᶜ) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
        ∃ ε > 0, Tendsto (fun n ↦
          ⨆ p : {p : unitInterval // (p : ℝ) ≤ (pStar n : ℝ) - δ * d n},
            marketLaw n p.1 (hyperbolaEvent n p.1 ε)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  sorry
